name: Outdoor Leisure 3-Seater Swing Chair
material: Steel with powder coating, 100% polyester top cover & seat (OEM color)
description: This porch swing is equipped with an adjustable awning up to 45° which effectively blocks the Sun and creates a comfortable shade. And the canopy is waterproof, Sun-resistant, colorfast, ideal for outdoor use. All cushions are filled with high-density padding for optimal comfort. Depending on your needs, these cushions can be removed by losing the hook and loop fasteners.
